epistemic_role: Exact complete single-star A2/A4 operator-action algebra on a 12-qubit patch; not a complete L=2 ground state, joint instrument, or public E2 channel
question: Do source-defined full star and triangle operators admit a consistent CZ-aware exact local representation under two red-X geometries and no, matched, or partial red-X actions?
source_basis: Jing et al. 2025, Appendix A.1 Eq. (A2)-(A4) and A.2/A.4 local red-X examples, archived PDF printed pages 10-13
Iqbal et al. 2023, Fig. 2 and caption: 12-body A_s = product of six adjacent-ring CZ factors times X on six outer qubits, with two color-triangle Z products, archived PDF printed page 2

fixed_operator_indexing.qubits: inner ring 0..5 alternating green at 0,2,4 and red at 1,3,5; outer X qubits 6..11
fixed_operator_indexing.star: A = product_{i=0}^{5} CZ(inner_i, inner_(i+1 mod 6)) times product_{j=6}^{11} X_j
fixed_operator_indexing.triangles: B_red=Z_1 Z_3 Z_5, B_green=Z_0 Z_2 Z_4
fixed_operator_indexing.local_projector: A4 star charge sector: (I-A)/2 times (I+B_red)/2 times (I+B_green)/2

matrix.independent_unit: all 4096 computational basis states of one source-local 12-qubit patch; exhaustive algebra, no stochastic sampling

competing_models.source_cz_aware: Exact action of the source's six-CZ ring star and two color triangles.
competing_models.pauli_only_surrogate: Dropping CZ would remove the geometry-dependent Z dressing; J6J already rejects general equality on arbitrary local inputs. Do not promote this surrogate as D4 physics.

acceptance: All pinned hashes match; A and both B operators are Hermitian involutions, commute locally, and the A4 charge projector is idempotent and vanishes outside both-triangle-vacuum sector.
For each of two red-X geometries and three actions, exhaustive basis conjugation matches the XOR-neighbor Z dressing of A and the red-triangle parity sign; matched actions restore original operators.
No action or partial action with residual red-X is not assigned a fabricated public E2 record; global flux clearance is not inferred from this single-star patch.
No full L=2 initial state, inter-star consistency, conditional probability, stochastic histories, schedule arms, bootstrap replicates, LER or threshold are claimed.
stop_rule: Fail closed on source operator/index ambiguity, provenance drift, involution/commutation/projector failure, or any branch-conjugation mismatch. Passing authorizes only explicit embedding of this local operator into the pinned multi-star L=2 geometry as the next gate.
